Beyond Travel Magazine - Supporting you around the world

Beyond Travel is our brand new, FREE digital magazine. Created with a simple purpose; to make travel more accessible, inclusive and most of all inspiring for adults with autism and learning disabilities.

Having grown from the heart of Go Beyond Holidays, its experiences and the unforgettable moments we see on every trip, we recognised a gap in the market. With nothing quite like it available, we felt there was a real need for a publication dedicated to sharing meaningful travel experiences, tips and guidance.

Whether you are new to travelling or an experienced adventurer, we hope the magazine becomes a source of ideas, inspiration and excitement for what’s possible through supported travel.
